title: Corner shop daylight and display restraint
objective: Increase useful daylight and display exposure in the sales room without overglazing the corner shop.

constraints.title: Corner shop daylight and display restraint
constraints.objective: Increase useful daylight and display exposure in the sales room without overglazing the corner shop.
hard_constraints: Edit the model only through the Bonsai/Blender GUI.
Preserve all IfcSpace, IfcWall, IfcSlab, and IfcDoor objects and their bounding boxes.
Do not delete, move, or resize site obstruction walls whose names begin with SITE-OBSTRUCTION.
Only IfcWindow geometry and optional IfcShadingDevice geometry may be changed or added.
Keep every window on an allowed facade for its room and within sill/head limits.
Keep each room window-to-wall ratio at or below its max_wwr.
Do not use IfcBuildingElementProxy or visual-only mesh objects as replacements for BIM elements.
invalid_conditions: Changed room count, room names, fixed wall/slab/door geometry, building envelope, or site obstruction geometry.
Windows placed on forbidden/private facades or outside room boundaries.
Over-limit room WWR, excessive window count, malformed windows, or oversized shading devices.
A submission that only writes score/design_summary/preview files without a valid IFC.

site.orientation: Project north is +Y; south facade is -Y; east facade is +X.
site.target_daylight_period: clear-sky working hours proxy, 09:00-15:00 local time
